model: IN485DAI001R000 (Daikin Sky and VRV gateway, BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: VRF / split air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit or group)
applies_to: Daikin Sky Air and VRV indoor units, connected on the P1P2 wired remote-controller bus (one unit or a group that acts as one).
summary: Intesis interface for one Daikin Sky or VRV indoor unit (or a group run as one) on the P1P2 remote-controller bus. DIP switch SW1-5 selects BACnet MS/TP (default) or Modbus RTU. It exposes 41 fixed objects: on/off, mode, setpoint, fan and both vane directions as _command/_status pairs, error and filter signals, occupancy logic, a remote lock and a virtual-temperature function.
notes: Object names follow each object's Object_Name property; the manual's summary table writes a few with different capitals (Setpoint_status, UserSetpoint_Status, Setpoint_command, OccupiedCoolSetpoint and siblings, UnoccupiedDeadBandAction).
The manual's property tables give FilterSign the identifier (Binary Input, 1) and AC_IU_address (Multistate Output, 1); the object list and this file use BI 6 and MV 1.
Reserved_1 (AV 9) is marked for internal use only. The summary table prints it with a footnote mark, so it can read as Reserved_11.
ErrorCodeM has 144 states; the full Daikin error code table is in the manual.
Temperature objects follow the °C/°F setting on DIP switch SW2 position 8.

source.title: IN485DAI001R000 Gateway - Daikin Sky and VRV Systems to BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU - User Manual

integration.summary: Connect the gateway anywhere on the P1P2 bus, leave SW1-5 off for BACnet MS/TP, set the MAC address on SW2, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read the _status objects. Several indoor units on one P1P2 bus behave as one unit.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point is documented; the gateway accepts commands once it talks to the unit. BV 2 LockRemoteControl can lock the wired remote.
integration.remote_sensors: Two options. With the gateway as P1P2 header (SW1-1 on), reading temperature from the remote (SW1-2 on) and the Daikin system set to use the remote's sensor, the value written to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command replaces the unit's reference temperature. Until a valid value is written the unit shows error CJ (45 on BACnet). Otherwise the Virtual Temperature function recalculates the setpoint from AO 1; BI 14 shows when it is active and AI 17 shows the BMS setpoint.
setup: SW1-5 off = BACnet MS/TP (default), on = Modbus RTU.
Baud rate on SW1 P6-P8; autobaud is the default and matches the other MS/TP devices.
MS/TP MAC address on SW2 P1-P7; device instance is 246000 + MAC unless Object_Identifier is written from BACnet (manual addressing until a factory reset).
SW1-1 sets the gateway as follower (default) or header on the P1P2 bus; a Daikin wired remote must take the other role.
SW3 enables the 120-ohm terminator and bus biasing. DIP changes apply after a reboot.
gotchas: Grouped units on one bus cannot be commanded separately.
The Occupancy MV and its four setpoint AVs drive built-in logic (BACnet only); leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) if the BMS handles scheduling.
Write the _command object and read the _status object; they share instance numbers in different object types.
